BETA Close X Drax Group plc has announced the purchase of 72,050 ordinary shares on 17 March 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback programme. The weighted average price paid per share was 902.0960 pence, with the lowest price at 891.5000 pence and the highest at 911.5000 pence. Following this transaction, Drax Group will have 432,275,674 ordinary shares in issue, with 95,344,815 held in treasury, and the total number of voting rights, excluding treasury shares, is 336,930,859. Since the programme's inception on 31 July 2025, Drax Group has repurchased a total of 8,203,415 ordinary shares for treasury. Disclaimer* Drax Group PLC 18 March 2026 18 March 2026 Drax Group plc Transactions in own shares Drax Group plc (Drax Group) announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the "Programme") announced on 31 July 2025, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 11 16/29 pence each (Ordinary Shares) on the London Stock Exchange through J.P. Morgan Securities plc. Date of purchase: 17 March 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 72,050 Lowest price paid per ordinary share (p): 891.5000 Highest price paid per ordinary share (p): 911.5000 Volume weighted average price paid per share (p): 902.0960 Following the above transaction, Drax Group will have 432,275,674 Ordinary Shares in issue, including treasury shares. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 95,344,815. The total number of voting rights in Drax Group, excluding treasury shares as at 17 March 2026 is 336,930,859. This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Drax Group under the FCA's Disclosure and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 31 July 2025, Drax Group has purchased 8,203,415 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for treasury.
